data.description:
## Description

**What**: Build bot-comment-scan adapter that reads GitHub PR bot review comments, applies (reviewer_id, github_comment_id) dedup (augmented with row_content_hash for Gitar Dashboard edits), and emits canonical telemetry events.

**Why**: Without dedup, every CI push would re-ingest every prior bot comment, ballooning the telemetry store. The dedup keys are the data contract that downstream queries depend on.

**Scope**:
- IN: bot-comment-scan adapter; (reviewer_id, github_comment_id) dedup with row_content_hash augmentation for Gitar Dashboard; ingestion telemetry events with tool_id; missing-telemetry-emit.sh graceful degradation (exit 0 + WARN to stderr)
- OUT: Per-bot parsing logic (covered by d3); CI workflow wiring (covered by d7); thread auto-resolve (covered by d5)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, Run twice against N-comment fixture: N events first, 0 second
  ← Satisfies: sc-5  (sc-5: "Bot-comment dedup is per `(reviewer_id, github_comment_id)` (augmented to include row_content_hash for Gitar Dashboard): the same comment is ingested ")
- When this story is complete, Missing telemetry-emit.sh: exit 0 + CI_WARNING to stderr
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "After this epic ships, a CodeRabbit / Gitar / Copilot review comment on a representative PR does NOT increment our cycle counter, does NOT enter the r")
- When this story is complete, S3 seed populates seen.log so subsequent ingest skips recorded
  ← Satisfies: sc-5  (sc-5: "Bot-comment dedup is per `(reviewer_id, github_comment_id)` (augmented to include row_content_hash for Gitar Dashboard): the same comment is ingested ")
- When this story is complete, Non-allowlisted Bot: 0 events + INFO 'skipping unknown bot author'
  ← Satisfies: sc-7  (sc-7: "`pr_comments.bot_authors` config controls the allowlist with case-insensitive matching; empty-string value fails fast at startup with a clear error. N")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] If telemetry-emit.sh is missing, CI must not fail — exit 0 + CI_WARNING ensures graceful degradation
- [Testing] Integration test runs adapter twice against an N-comment fixture: expect N events first run, 0 events second run

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a telemetry-collect engineer, I can ingest bot review comments via bot-comment-scan with (reviewer_id, github_comment_id) dedup so each comment is recorded exactly once
